a.lede: Report identifies three factors that led to blackout: a bug, malfunctioning internal connections and server capacity Microsoft has identified the root causes of the global outage that crippled Outlook, Exchange and a host of other vital office software last week. The office software giant issued an initial report on Monday that identified three factors that led to the 24-hour blackout
a.title: Microsoft identifies months-old bug as a root cause of global outage

b.lede: One think tank’s estimate puts the cost of the outage at $7 billion.
b.title: Microsoft doesn’t ‘have an ETA for full recovery’ on outage yet
